baseline_models.focus_anchor: The doubled root س ب ق, first as an active plural and then as a cognate accusative, intensifies precedence as the ayah's entire action.
baseline_models.mechanism: Agents move ahead of peers or initiate an action before others can do so; the repetition makes achieved precedence, rather than mere motion, the salient result.

activation_trace.role: The ordinary advance-and-race branch supplies both the forward motion and the function of taking the lead decisively.

changed_reading.after: They actively gain precedence, with the doubled root presenting lead-taking as a completed and emphatic function.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The same doubled root س ب ق can profile the result of precedence from the pursuer's side: the one ahead has passed beyond being caught.
baseline_models.mechanism: The race is modeled as pursuit, and success consists not simply in occupying first place but in making the pursuer fail to reach the moving target.

activation_trace.role: The eluding-a-pursuer branch converts precedence into successful non-capture and supplies the race's adversarial geometry.

changed_reading.before: They are ahead in a neutral ordering.
changed_reading.after: They get so far ahead that what follows cannot overtake or contain them.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The focus inventory attaches the contest-stake branch directly to the twice-occurring root س ب ق.
baseline_models.mechanism: Precedence is a contest with a consequential object at issue; the leader's position determines who receives or forfeits what was put into the race.

activation_trace.role: The race-stake branch adds an adjudicated consequence to speed and makes precedence outcome-bearing.

changed_reading.before: They race only to establish relative speed.
changed_reading.after: They race under stakes, so gaining precedence also settles a consequential claim.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: A technical branch under the focus root names the paired leg-tethers of a hunting bird, preserving a material reading within س ب ق itself.
baseline_models.mechanism: The phrase can momentarily evoke controlled limbs or restraints associated with a swift bird, making racing power something rigged, held, and potentially released rather than simply free-running.

activation_trace.role: The bird-leg tether branch supplies a concrete apparatus of constrained speed and a latent release mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The racers are imagined as intrinsically and freely swift.
changed_reading.after: Their precedence may be pictured through controlled avian motion whose speed depends on restraint and release.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening sequence supplies a functional relay: removal from a settled place, release of a fastening, rapid traversal, decisive precedence, and then consequence-aware administration of a command. Racing is therefore the transfer stage that gets an operation ahead in time so governance can follow.

activation_trace.role: Removal from a fixed seat supplies the relay's initiating displacement and frees what will move.
The knot-and-untying image supplies controlled release as the enabling step before traversal.
Running or swimming supplies sustained passage through a medium and carries the released movement toward precedence.
Advance and competition supply the relay's decisive gain in position, the focus stage being revised.
Planning with regard to outcomes turns the gained lead into coordinated downstream administration.
An obligating command supplies the object that the whole relay ultimately puts into effect.

structural_cues: Ayat 79:1-5 repeat a feminine active plural followed by an emphatic verbal noun, placing the focus in a formally matched five-part chain.
The two occurrences of فَ place precedence after traversal and administration after precedence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the ordered branch images and connective sequence; I infer that adjacent stages enable and hand off to one another. A live alternative is that the five oath-members are parallel classes rather than phases of one operation.

changed_reading.before: Independent racers simply move faster than competitors.
changed_reading.after: The racers perform the lead-gaining stage in a coordinated operation: extraction and release enable passage, passage gains precedence, and precedence enables command to be administered.

context_deltas.mechanism: The baseline escape model meets an ordered follower, explicit return, and a single vocal impulse that produces abrupt arrival. These cues preserve temporary lead-and-chase geometry but deny that precedence amounts to permanent evasion.

activation_trace.role: The elusion branch supplies the focus-only claim that gaining enough lead can defeat a pursuer.
Following that reaches or catches supplies pressure against any reading of unlimited escape.
Coming directly after another fixes the chase as ordered succession rather than disconnected speed.
Return to a prior place supplies the reversal that can cancel apparent forward escape.
Going back again reinforces recurrence and closes a route imagined as one-way flight.
A forceful vocal check supplies the compact causal impulse that terminates the attempted evasion.
Numerical singleness makes one impulse sufficient, sharply limiting the temporal room for escape.

structural_cues: The paired wording تتبعها الرادفة explicitly places one event behind another.
The skeptical questions about return are answered by one cry and the branchless 79:14 cue of sudden presence on the exposed surface.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies pursuit, return, repetition, one check, and sudden arrival; I infer that the one impulse closes the escape interval. The racers could instead be executors of that recall and never its fleeing objects.

changed_reading.before: The racers gain an irreversible lead and cannot be caught.
changed_reading.after: Their precedence is a bounded lead within an ordered sequence; in the surah's return mechanism, no amount of forward distance guarantees final evasion.

context_deltas.mechanism: Moses is sent forward and offers guidance whose branch can itself denote a leader at the front, while Pharaoh turns his back yet continues purposeful motion toward a claim of supremacy. The contrast revises precedence from raw velocity into motion whose direction and end determine whether being 'ahead' is genuine.

activation_trace.role: The advance branch supplies the contested idea of what it means to be genuinely in front.
Going forth supplies commissioned forward motion at the narrative's opening.
The guide who goes in front supplies a normative model of precedence that leads toward a destination.
Turning one's back supplies directional reversal and makes subsequent speed morally ambiguous.
Purposeful movement toward an objective shows that energetic striving can continue after a wrong turn.
Dominance and mastery supply Pharaoh's false destination for his counter-directed striving.

structural_cues: The command اذهب and offer أهديك face the later sequence أدبر يسعى in opposite directions.
Pharaoh's movement culminates in a superlative claim, الأعلى, rather than in guidance.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies opposed trajectories and a branch in which the guide stands at the front; I infer that the focus race can be evaluated by destination, not speed alone. The alternative is that the narrative contrast does not identify the oath's racers at all.

changed_reading.after: True precedence is directed advance: guidance can lead from the front, whereas vigorous striving after turning away only accelerates a false claim to supremacy.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus branch's race-stake meets explicit loss, a claim to dominance, capture, deterrent punishment, and the paired latter/former. Together they activate a contest in which asserted primacy is adjudicated and its loser forfeits across both temporal poles.

activation_trace.role: The staked-race branch supplies the otherwise latent idea that precedence settles a consequential claim.
Commercial loss supplies forfeiture language and gives the contest a losing side.
A claim of mastery supplies the rank being contested rather than merely a claim of speed.
Seizure and capture supply the concrete adjudication that defeats the claimant to highest rank.
A punishment designed to deter others supplies the public consequence or forfeiture of losing.
Laterness supplies one temporal pole across which the adverse outcome is displayed.
Beginning and prior position supply the opposite pole and directly echo the focus concern with precedence.

structural_cues: The superlative claim الأعلى is immediately followed by seizure and exemplary punishment.
الآخرة والأولى binds the result to both latter and former rather than one isolated moment.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a lexical stake, loss, claimed dominance, capture, punishment, and first/last poles; I treat punishment as the forfeited stake of a sovereignty contest. It may instead be a consequence narrative with no wager structure.

changed_reading.before: The racers compete for an unspecified prize.
changed_reading.after: The race can stage an adjudicated claim to precedence: false supremacy loses its stake through capture and a consequence spanning the latter and the former.

context_deltas.mechanism: The creation passage orders assembly, elevation, completion, emergence of hidden provision, anchoring, and eventual benefit. This activates precedence as prerequisite work: what goes ahead does so to prepare a stable field in which later life can function.

activation_trace.role: The advance branch supplies temporal priority and lets racing be read as going first to prepare conditions.
Joining components into a construction supplies the first infrastructure-building operation.
Elevation supplies vertical formation within the ordered preparation.
Integrity and completion supply the transition from construction to a usable ordered whole.
Bringing something out of concealment supplies the emergence of resources from the prepared earth.
Firm settling supplies stabilization before the passage names beneficiaries.
Useful provision supplies the downstream purpose for which the prior operations go ahead.

structural_cues: Ayat 79:27-33 present a succession of completed operations before ending with benefit for humans and livestock.
The earth's resources emerge before mountains are anchored and the final beneficiary clause is stated.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the ordered operations and final benefit; I infer a prerequisite relation in which earlier acts prepare later habitability. The sequence can alternatively be descriptive accumulation without assigning the focus racers a preparatory role.

changed_reading.before: The racers seek first place over rivals.
changed_reading.after: They can be read as advance operations whose precedence is useful because it prepares, completes, and stabilizes conditions for what comes later.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing judgment passage remembers prior striving, exposes rank, names preference as putting one option first, opposes that preference with restraining the living self from desire, and assigns each trajectory a receiving refuge. The external race becomes an internal ordering contest whose earlier priorities run ahead into a revealed destination.

activation_trace.role: Advance and initiative supply the focus anchor for reading ethical choices as things placed ahead.
Work and acquired action supply the accumulated course that is later remembered.
Precedence becoming visible through distinction supplies public disclosure of what had truly come ahead.
Putting something first in beginning or choice translates physical precedence into priority selection.
Joining a receiving shelter supplies the adverse terminus reached by one priority trajectory.
Checking and holding back action supplies the counterforce that prevents desire from taking the lead.
The living self supplies the arena in which competing priorities are ordered.
Inclination of desire supplies the rival impulse that seeks to move first.
Joining a receiving shelter again supplies the contrasting terminus of the restrained trajectory.

structural_cues: The matched result clauses in 79:39 and 79:41 use the same مأوى construction for opposite destinations.
The two conditional portraits oppose preferring worldly life to fearing the station and restraining desire.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies remembered striving, disclosed precedence, explicit preference, restraint, desire, and matched refuges; I infer that the opening race prefigures an ethical priority mechanism. The racers may instead remain external oath-agents, with this later pattern only analogical.

changed_reading.before: The ayah depicts agents overtaking one another in space.
changed_reading.after: It can also depict priorities and prior actions racing ahead: what the self puts first or restrains becomes a trajectory whose true precedence is exposed at its refuge.

context_deltas.mechanism: The final questions give the Hour a mooring and endpoint while warning precedes it; once seen, human lingering contracts to an evening or a morning stretch. The focus race therefore acquires an event-time scale: rapid advance runs toward a fixed terminus and overtakes ordinary estimates of duration.

activation_trace.role: Advance supplies the kinetic frame whose scale shifts from racers in space to events moving through time.
A vessel's stopping at its mooring supplies a fixed arrival point for the accelerating timeline.
The limit at which something ends supplies the timeline's divinely held terminus.
A warning that awakens caution supplies anticipatory action that must get ahead of arrival.
Stopping and slowness supply the duration that retrospective event-time radically compresses.
Evening-time supplies one short boundary for perceived worldly duration.
The forenoon's extension supplies the other short boundary and completes the compressed day-scale.

structural_cues: Ayat 79:42-46 move from asking when the Hour will be fixed to perceiving the entire stay as part of one day.
The authority over the endpoint is withheld from the warner even though warning must occur before it.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies mooring, endpoint, warning, delay, evening, and forenoon; I infer that the focus's forward motion gives these cues a shared acceleration-to-arrival mechanism. The opening racers may have no direct temporal identity beyond setting the surah's kinetic register.

changed_reading.before: The racers pass competitors across a physical course.
changed_reading.after: They can figure event-time advancing toward a fixed mooring, overtaking human duration until a whole stay contracts to an evening or forenoon.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates a technical bird-tether branch rather than the ordinary racing sense and links the opening to a remote mooring cue. It remains anchored in the exact focus inventory and gains a coherent release-traverse-restrain material cycle from packet branches. Downstream prose should label it a lexical-material possibility, not identify the racers as birds or treat the mooring as a literal shared object.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus root's B003 branch supplies paired leg-tethers as a concrete apparatus attached to swift avian movement.

activation_trace.role: The bird-leg restraints supply the focus-anchored material object whose control conditions speed.
Tying and untying a loop supplies the release action that converts restraint into available motion.
Running or swimming supplies the free traversal made possible after release.
Mooring supplies terminal restraint, closing the material cycle after rapid traversal.

changed_reading.after: Precedence may arise inside a controlled cycle: tethered capacity is released, traverses rapidly, and is finally brought to a mooring.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the packet's non-dominant س ع ي to س و ع mapping alongside the ordinary striving target. Both targets are explicitly supplied for the same source occurrence, and the reading stays anchored to the focus's advance branch through the question of whether motion truly gains precedence. Downstream prose should call this a split-mapping activation and avoid presenting aimless wandering as the standard lexical meaning of يسعى.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The ordinary focus branch makes forward initiative the criterion against which Pharaoh's post-turn motion is tested.

activation_trace.role: Advance and racing supply the focus criterion of genuine lead-taking.
Turning the back supplies the directional reversal that makes the following sprint suspect.
Purposeful movement supplies the visible energy and intended objective of Pharaoh's striving.
The split target's neglected, directionless going supplies a counter-reading in which energetic motion fails to become true advance.

changed_reading.before: Energetic purposeful motion necessarily puts its agent ahead.
changed_reading.after: A sprint can counterfeit precedence: after turning away, purpose and energy may coexist with directionless going and fail to produce a genuine lead.

strongest_changes: The matched opening forms revise generic racing into the lead-gaining stage of an extraction-release-traversal-administration relay.
The return sequence weakens permanent escape: followers, reversal, and one cry make any lead temporary within an inescapable order.
The final moral contrast turns spatial precedence into priority: striving, preference, restraint, desire, and refuge expose what the self placed first.
The closing mooring and compressed stay rescale racing from physical speed to event-time overtaking human estimates of duration.
summary.what_was_special: The focus ayah contains only one root repeated emphatically, yet the whole-surah packet repeatedly reconfigures precedence through sequence, pursuit, guidance, claimed supremacy, preparatory order, ethical preference, and temporal arrival. Its marginal stake, elusion, and bird-tether branches generated distinct mechanisms rather than merely decorating the ordinary race sense.
remaining_uncertainties: The packet does not settle the identity of the feminine plural racers, so operational roles should not be converted into a single named referent.
Several strong mechanisms depend on reading surah order as causal handoff or thematic recurrence; parallel description remains live.
The staked-race, bird-tether, and split-mapping readings are branch-valid but form-distant and require explicit exploratory qualification.
